dct_title_s: Southern Islands (Nanpo Shoto), Hachijo Jima to Kazan Retto, Japan : from Japanese surveys between 1911 and 1913
dct_description_sm: Nautical chart of the area around the southern islands in Japan. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. Depth shown by bathymetric soundings.
"Small corrections. Printed: ... Mar '44. From other sources: III '44."

Insets Hachijo Jima, from a Japanese survey in 1913 Scale 1:145,103 -- Kaminato Hakuchi, from a Japanese survey in 1913 Scale 1:28,804 -- Yayene Hakuchi, from a Japanese survey in 1913 Scale 1:28,939 -- Borawazawa Hakuchi, from a Japanese survey in 1913 Scale 1:29,039 -- Aoga Shima, from a Japanese survey in 1913 Scale 1:144,955 -- Tori Shima, from a Japanese survey in 1913 Scale 1:36,228.
dct_publisher_sm: Published June, 1918, at the Hydrographic Office under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy
